infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SpotFix requires access to your camera so you can photograph civic issues like potholes and damaged infrastructure.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SpotFix uses your location to tag the exact physical position of reported civic problems.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SpotFix allows you to access device contacts to alert municipal officers, local representatives, or neighbors about an issue.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SpotFix to access your camera to photograph civic issues.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow SpotFix to access your location to pinpoint issues on the civic map.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow SpotFix to access your contacts to share issue updates.
